| description = Confirmed spawns at (-2770, 2470), (-2483, 2483), and (-3240, -1822). Likely spawn at 498, -1991. Possible spawn at -3503, 2335. 

A highland lion placeholders path in long loops that cross the guard tower hill and can be nearly any mob that spawns normally in North Karana. The guards sometimes kill these placeholders but they can spawn as willowisps, which the guards will not attack, and some paths are outside of the guards' aggro range. Killing all of the spawns that cross the guard tower hill will spawn approximately 3 a highland lions per hour.
